posts.title: China NEV retail sales fall 13% in October 1-25 as peak-season demand stays weak
posts.summary:
NEV retail sales totaled 753,000 units, down 1% from the same period in September.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: China's NEV retail sales dropped 13% year-on-year to 753,000 units during the first 25 days of October, signaling persistent weakness in the peak selling season.
Despite the retail slump, NEV wholesale volumes grew 3% year-on-year to over 1 million units, indicating a divergence between dealer inventory and consumer demand.
The broader passenger car market remains under significant pressure, with retail sales falling 26% year-on-year during the same period.
NEV retail penetration reached 65.7%, a slight decline from September's record levels, reflecting the ongoing challenge of maintaining growth in a saturated market.

posts.title: GWM targets Q1 2027 production at Bulgaria base in European push
posts.summary:
The Lovech base will have a planned annual capacity of 50,000 vehicles, with the Ora 5 as its first production model.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Great Wall Motor (GWM) will establish a production base in Lovech, Bulgaria, with an annual capacity of 50,000 vehicles starting in Q1 2027.
The facility will serve as a strategic hub for GWM's European expansion, connecting to existing distribution networks in Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands.
GWM plans to launch at least 10 new models and variants in the European market over the next two years to accelerate local supply chain integration.
The Ora 5 has been selected as the first model for local production, following extensive road testing and engineering adjustments by GWM's Munich-based R&D team.

posts.title: CATL unveils 9-MWh Tener+ storage system, deepens Australian presence
posts.summary:
Compared with conventional solutions, Tener+ can reduce container requirements by up to 40% and cut project footprints by 12%.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: CATL unveiled the Tener+ energy storage system, a 9-MWh solution designed to reduce container requirements by 40% and project footprints by 12% compared to conventional systems.
The system features a 25-year design life and intelligent thermal management, with configurations available for zero-degradation performance or high-temperature resilience.
CATL is aggressively expanding its Australian footprint, signing three new cooperation memorandums and debuting its Tener Sodium-ion storage technology in the region.
The sodium-ion storage system supports modular deployment and is rated for over 10,000 cycles at 45°C, providing a viable alternative to lithium-ion for grid-scale projects.

posts.title: Foundations of Power Management in the Age of AI
posts.summary:
Make every layer of your hardware PDN-aware and reach your maximum compute density.
The post Foundations of Power Management in the Age of AI appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Reducing voltage margin by just 50 mV can result in significant efficiency gains, potentially saving 17 kW per rack in high-performance AI datacenters.
Over-margining to compensate for unpredictable AI workload dynamics leads to lost compute density and reduced token throughput.
Effective power delivery network (PDN) management requires a systematic approach, including reactive or preemptive droop mitigation and co-architected control loops.
Movellus's Aeonic platform is positioned to help silicon and platform teams address these power challenges through integrated architectural control.

posts.title: Creating AI value with enterprise context
posts.summary: Across a business, any number of AI platforms, systems, and tools may be at work simultaneously—for example, AI-powered customer platforms, conversational assistants, and workflow and process automation tools. Each one is sophisticated, advanced, and quick to respond. But, when set to work, the outcomes and actions that emerge may be wrong, confused, or lacking a…
bullets: Only 16% of organizations report extracting transformative value from AI deployments, with 23% seeing minimal to no return on investment.
The primary barrier to AI ROI is a lack of 'enterprise context,' where models operate without a deep understanding of specific business data and internal systems.
A 'context layer' architecture is proposed to bridge the gap between raw business data and AI platforms, enabling models to function with governed, machine-usable intelligence.
Most enterprises remain in the pilot phase (38%) or limited co-pilot assistance (35%), with only 12% having fully deployed AI agents.
